text: Andorran licence plates have an **orange dot** on the left side and can be regularly found throughout the country.
NOTE: Within Europe, this plate is unique to Andorra.
text_zh: 安道爾的車牌左側有一個**橘色圓點**，在全國各地都能經常看到。
注意：在歐洲境內，這種車牌是安道爾獨有的。

text: Andorra **only has Generation 2 and Generation 3** coverage. In all Generation 3 coverage, a medium-short antenna is visible on the Google car.
Generation 3 is by far the most common. Almost all of Generation 2 is overwritten and is mostly confined to a couple of smaller off-roads.
text_zh: 安道爾**只有第二代和第三代**街景覆蓋。在所有第三代街景覆蓋中，Google 車上可看到一根中短天線。
第三代街景是迄今為止最常見的。幾乎所有第二代街景都已被覆蓋，主要局限於一些較小的非鋪裝道路。

text: All the Generation 3 coverage was taken in October, meaning that many deciduous trees have **autumn colours**.
text_zh: 所有第三代街景覆蓋都是在十月拍攝的，這表示許多落葉樹都呈現**秋天的顏色**。

text: Andorra has a lot of these **stone** buildings. They can be seen almost everywhere in the country.
NOTE: These buildings can also be found close to Andorra, in the French and Spanish Pyrenees.
text_zh: 安道爾有許多這類**石造**建築，幾乎全國各地都可見到。
注意：這些建築在安道爾附近，法國和西班牙的庇里牛斯山脈也能找到。

text: Andorran snow poles are made out of **wood** and can have a variety** **of** colours** on them.
text_zh: 安道爾的雪樁由**木頭**製成，上面可能有各種**顏色**。

text: **Catalan** is the main language in Andorra. It is a Romance language that is closely related to Spanish and French.

If you are unfamiliar with Romance languages, it can be hard to distinguish between Catalan and Spanish. If you see **i** instead of **y** (“and” in English), it is Catalan. In addition, more Catalan words end with consonants.
NOTE: The Catalan language is also used in eastern Spain: in Catalonia, the Valencian community and the Balearic islands.
text_zh: **加泰隆尼亞語**是安道爾的主要語言。它是一種羅曼語系語言，與西班牙語和法語密切相關。
如果你不熟悉羅曼語系語言，可能會很難區分加泰隆尼亞語和西班牙語。如果你看到**i**而不是**y**（英文的「和」），那就是加泰隆尼亞語。此外，更多加泰隆尼亞語單字以子音結尾。
注意：加泰隆尼亞語也在西班牙東部使用：在加泰隆尼亞、瓦倫西亞自治區和巴利亞利群島。

text: The Catalan word for street is **“carrer”**.
text_zh: 加泰隆尼亞語的街道是 **“carrer”**。

text: These kilometre markers with** CG and CS **road numbers are found in Andorra.
NOTE: Similar kilometre marker designs can be found in Spain.
text_zh: 在安道爾可以找到這些帶有**CG和CS**道路編號的公里標誌。
注意：類似的公里標誌設計在西班牙也能找到。

text: Andorra uses **yellow** reflectors on its guardrails.
NOTE: Within Europe, yellow reflectors are only found in Andorra, Spain and Belgium. For a good overview of European guardrails, see [this infographic](/images/andorra/europeguardrail.png).
text_zh: 安道爾在其護欄上使用**黃色**反光板。
注意：在歐洲，黃色反光片只出現在安道爾、西班牙和比利時。如需歐洲護欄的詳細概覽，請參閱[此資訊圖表](/images/andorra/europeguardrail.png)。

text: The Andorran bollard has an **orange** reflector and can be occasionally found on the main highways.
NOTE: This bollard can also be found in **Spain**.
text_zh: 安道爾的路樁帶有**橘色**反光片，偶爾可在主要高速公路上看到。
注意：這種路樁也可在**西班牙**找到。

text: **Yellow** and **turquoise-green** traffic cones are used in the whole country.
text_zh: 全國使用**黃色**和**藍綠色**的交通錐。

text: Pedestrian signs** **have **8 stripes**.
NOTE: Spain is the only other European country that has pedestrian signs with 8 stripes.
text_zh: 行人標誌** **有 **8 條條紋**。
注意：西班牙是歐洲唯一另一個行人標誌有 8 條條紋的國家。

text: Andorra has a lot of Generation 2 **snow trekkers**, especially on ski resorts.
NOTE: Other countries have snow trekkers as well, but Andorra has the highest amount for its size.
text_zh: 安道爾有許多第二代**雪地徒步拍攝車**，尤其是在滑雪場。
注意：其他國家也有雪地徒步拍攝車，但安道爾相對其面積而言數量最多。

text: **Andorra la Vella** is a capital city surrounded by high mountains, making it recognisable.
NOTE: It is the highest European capital with an altitude of 1023 metres.
text_zh: **安道爾城**是一座四周環繞著高山的首都，因此易於辨識。
注意：它是歐洲海拔最高的首都，海拔 1023 公尺。

text: In the capital Andorra la Vella you can often see the **Caldea tower** and the **sky wheel**.
text_zh: 在首都安道爾城（Andorra la Vella），你經常可以看到**卡爾迪亞塔**和**天空之輪**。

text: **Pas de la Casa**, a touristy city in eastern Andorra, can be easily recognized by the plethora of shops and hotels. As it is located at an altitude of 2080 metres, there are no trees visible on the mountains surrounding it.
text_zh: **帕斯德拉卡薩**是安道爾東部的一個觀光城市，很容易透過大量的商店和飯店來辨識。由於它位於海拔 2080 公尺處，周圍的山上看不到任何樹木。
